docs.family: ZWJ family emoji, an RTL run, and an astral-plane symbol.

source:
## Semantics: U1 residual (rs#297) — the hard unicode inventory:
## emoji ZWJ sequences (multi-codepoint graphemes must match as one
## literal byte-run), RTL text (bidi is rendering-only; byte order is
## the contract), and astral-plane codepoints (4-byte UTF-8).
grammar ConformanceUnicodeHard version "1.0.0" mode "v1" {
  ## ZWJ family emoji, an RTL run, and an astral-plane symbol.
  family = %x1F468 %x200D %x1F469 %x200D %x1F467 %x200D %x1F466
  shalom = %x5E9 %x5DC %x5D5 %x5DD
  astral = %x1F600
  line = ( family / shalom / astral ) as glyph

  entry main: line

  test main {
    accept "👨‍👩‍👧‍👦"
    accept "שלום"
    accept "😀"
    reject "👨‍👩"
    reject "שלו"
  }
}
